summary: Atomfall entries added from the live guide-pack catalogue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Atomfall
entries.definitive_edition: Atomfall Complete Edition on Windows PC (base game + The Wicked Isle + The Red Strain + both supply bundles)

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulation branch.

primary.version: Atomfall Complete Edition (Steam / Epic Games Store / Microsoft Store)
primary.why: Complete Edition is the only route that bundles both story expansions, The Wicked Isle (a new region off the Cumberland coast) and The Red Strain (Test Site Moriah, with new infected enemy types), plus the Basic and Enhanced Supply Bundles, so it is simultaneously the most complete and the highest-fidelity option. The free title update that shipped alongside it also adds fast travel, combat and AI refinements, and a Phobias Safe Mode.
primary.how_to_play: Play Atomfall Complete Edition on Windows PC. Record storefront/build, expansion ownership (Wicked Isle + Red Strain), whether the post-launch title update's fast travel and Phobias Safe Mode are in use, difficulty, and which of the competing endings the run pursues.

all_releases.fidelity: Highest settings/resolution ceiling; Complete Edition carries both story expansions and both supply bundles.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity and the only fully complete content route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen console route; day-one Game Pass availability.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient (day-one Game Pass) but console-capped settings.
skip: no exclusive content and lower settings ceiling than PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No conflict: Complete Edition on PC is both the most complete content set and the highest fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Buying the base game alone leaves both story expansions out, check that the purchased edition is the Complete bundle, not the base or Deluxe SKU.
